# Strictly non-cheat: ZERO free gold! Grants modest debt/inflation stabilization in exchange for
# real prestige, diplomatic reputation, mercenary cost, and offensive expansion penalties.

oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity_mode = {
	potential_trigger = {
		is_ai = yes
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
		at_war = no
		OR = {
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
			num_loans >= 5
		}
	}

	# Stabilization relief (helps AI climb out of debt spiral without printing free gold)
	bank_interest = -0.01
	bond_interest = -0.01
	monthly_inflation = -0.002
	fort_maintenance_efficiency = 0.15
	monthly_war_exhaustion = -0.02

	# Meaningful austerity tradeoffs (diplomatic/prestige cost + anti-merc + expansion pause)
	monthly_prestige = -0.08
	diplomatic_reputation = -1.0
	mercenary_maintenance_efficiency = -0.25
	aggressiveness_modifier = -0.35
	carefulness_modifier = 0.30
	ai_months_between_wars = 24
	gold_importance_modifier = 0.35
}

oe_ai2_postwar_retrenchment = {
	potential_trigger = {
		is_ai = yes
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
		at_war = no
		war_exhaustion >= 8
		is_during_bankruptcy = no
		num_loans < 5
	}

	# Postwar recovery discipline
	monthly_war_exhaustion = -0.03
	stability_investment = 0.05
	fort_maintenance_efficiency = 0.10

	# Meaningful restraint tradeoffs
	monthly_prestige = -0.05
	aggressiveness_modifier = -0.25
	carefulness_modifier = 0.20
	ai_months_between_wars = 18
}
